THE PARTS. The list of parts in WF-05 («Parts and dimensions») is older than the product: name the parts as the tree is today and say in `result.issues` that the list of the workflow text has to be corrected by DOC-UPDATER. Measure the tree yourself; ORCH's starting list, to be corrected by you: (1) app/ — the product (server, api, db, public pages and the stage office, scripts, content, tests, the Vercel settings) together with its production https://sai-team.vercel.app (main e0a425b; only harmless GET requests, a handful, no load); (2) tools/src/team — the agent engine; (3) tools/src/picker and tools/src/web — the picker site and the Sai Team page; (4) tools/src/pixel-office; (5) the rest of tools/src (the idea selection tools, handoffs, traces, the nine top-level files) with tools/package.json; (6) .claude/ — the role files and the settings; (7) documents and bookkeeping — docs/, decisions/, STATE.md, PLAN.md, CLAUDE.md, README.md, handoffs/; (8) .github/workflows — the checks on GitHub. Split or merge differently if the files say so, and give each part a short Latin name for the paths. ORCH'S HINTS (they add to the passports, they do not replace them): (a) app/ appeared after AUD-001 and was never checked by an audit; (b) the `check` workflow on GitHub FAILED on branch m0-records at commit 3c66ba3 (run 44875023688, 2026-11-21) while it is green on main e0a425b (2026-11-21) and on the snapshot branches ci/m1-status-1 and ci/m1-words-1 (which carry the tree of main plus app/): find out from the log (`gh run view 44875023688 --log-failed`, read-only) which tests failed and name the part; the head f72eaa7 itself has never been run on GitHub as a whole; (c) `cd tools && npm run -s handoffs-check` prints one violation (handoffs/M0DOCS-20261117-01/step-05c-test-designer.json, PENDING in a commit since 2026-11-18) and the runs ISS-0092-20261117-01 and M0DOCS-20261117-01 stand unfinished; the handoffs of the two live runs (M1WORDS-20261122-02 steps 04 to 07 and this audit) are PENDING because their agents are working now: they are not abandoned; (d) the work line m0-records and main are two lines: 27 commits against 1; (e) the owner asked for the audit in order to find the errors and have them fixed, so nothing is postponed for lack of agents: still mark «можно перенести» where it is true, ORCH takes those rows too; (f) the last re-check of the `done` requirements was 2026-10-27 (AUD-001, 33 requirements); today 42 are `done` (nine became `done` after AUD-001: name them from the file); the owner asked about the project as a whole, so the dimension «Requirements» is in the plan: list every `done` requirement with the reason for its re-check (changed files that its criteria name, never re-checked, or the term), and say which of them can be checked on this PC by reading and read-only commands and which need a test run (those are checked against the GitHub record of main e0a425b, runs of 2026-11-21, or are «not checked» with the reason). ALSO, FOR THE OWNER'S THIRD POINT: add to the scope file a separate list `not_built` — what the plan and the requirements promise and the tree does not hold yet: every requirement that is not `done` (status, milestone or stage if the files name one, one line of what is missing), grouped by the stages of decisions/0127 (0b, 1, 7a, 2, 4a, 3, 5, 4b, 7b, 6) where the files allow it and «unplaced» otherwise. This list is a map for ORCH, not a finding. Every fact of a passport has its source (a command with its output, or a file and line). Read the history with read-only git in <Sai> (the fixed copy has only the work line). The time comes from the clock (`date -u`). RULES OF THIS PC (decisions/0110, 0127 Г, 0129): do NOT run `npm run check`, `cd app && npm run ...`, `node --test`, the tools test scripts or the e2e test files here; they run only on GitHub in Linux, and their record is read with `gh run view` (read-only). No git commit, push, pull, checkout, stash, reset or tag in the project. Files keep LF line endings. Never write the name or a path of the reference product into a Sai file (the `traces` check). issues.text: The list «Parts and dimensions» in docs/workflows/WF-05-health-audit.md is older than the tree (five parts, no picker, no Sai Team, no app/, no e2e kit, no CI files, handoffs in no part). DOC-UPDATER has to correct it; the scout named ten parts, same boundaries as AUD-001 for tools-core, pixel-office, team, picker, claude.

Corrections to ORCH’s starting list: (a) tools/src/web is kept with tools/src/team, not with the picker (21 import lines from 15 team modules, none from the picker; AUD-001 had the same boundary); (b) the e2e kit (tools/test/e2e, 16 files, 8009 lines) is its own part; (c) documents and bookkeeping are split into docs and records (1632 of 2970 tracked files are records); (d) ci (.github, .githooks) is its own part, not part of «.github/workflows» as a row of coverage. Other facts of the task were confirmed: 27 commits against 1, nine requirements became done after AUD-001, ci/m1-status-1 and ci/m1-words-1 equal main plus 6 app files, the one handoffs-check violation.

Task hint (b) asked which tests failed in run 44875023688: none failed. The run stopped at handoffs-check (step 4 of 6), so no test of tools/ has ever run on GitHub for the work line, and tools/test/current-docs.test.js (2239 lines) and the REQ-110 guards have no test record at all. The same violation fails the three runs of the work-line tree. A green check of the head needs the step 05c handoff of M0DOCS-20261117-01 finished first (decisions/0127 Л).

The traces check does not see paths of a Windows machine: 26 tracked handoffs of the head carry the user name of this PC in a path while `npm run -s traces` prints «следов 0». It was noted before in handoffs/E2E104-20261103-01/step-01f-code-design-validator.json (backslash paths not seen by hasHomePath). ORCH replaced the paths in the records (6cb68b1) but the rule is unchanged, so the next run can put them back; none of the 26 files is on origin. Candidate for an ISS defect and an anti-patterns entry (AP-050 repeat). The scout did not open or edit any of them.

The coverage row of WF-05 says the auditor runs `cd tools && npm run check` himself; on this PC that is forbidden (decisions/0110, 0129), so the coverage auditors can only read the tests, the GitHub record and a fresh clone without a run. ORCH should word the coverage and requirement handoffs accordingly («not checked» for a test run that has no GitHub record).

The classification of criteria by way of checking is by keywords (scope file, requirements_recheck.method.limits): «names a test» is an upper bound of what needs a run; 42 criteria are surely read-only; the criteria of REQ-002 to REQ-006 were read in full. The count of requirement files that differ between main and the head leaves out whole-folder mentions (tools/src, tools/test, app/test, app/public, app/server) and template paths; RELEASE-VALIDATOR reads each criterion itself.

The part of each of the 102 open defects was decided by reading its title and first lines in one pass (not each file in full); defects about tests are placed by the part of the code the test file pins. A defect that names two parts is listed in both (shared ones: ISS-0092 in four parts, ISS-0057 in ci and docs, ISS-0099 and ISS-0101 in ci and docs, ISS-0106 and ISS-0108 and ISS-0118 in e2e and another part). The severity and the status are read from the first line of each file and equal STATE.md.

Not measured by the scout: whether the hook of .claude/settings.json (sh) runs on this Windows PC; the content of the Vercel settings; the checks that spend time (npm audit, npm outdated need the network: not done here, they stay with DEPENDENCY-AUDITOR, «not checked» if the network is missing); the live behaviour of production beyond one GET of /api/health.

Parallel work (AP-008): the fixed copy has no handoff of the live runs; the project now has the untracked M1WORDS-20261122-02 steps 04-07 and this audit’s handoff, which may write app/test/unit/texts.test.js and app/test/e2e/landing.test.js. The passports of app and its requirements are those of f72eaa7; a later edit of these two files changes the answer for REQ-111 and REQ-113 only.

REQ-110 is `pending` although its code is in the tree and passed both reviews (run ISS-0092-20261117-01 stands after step 05b, tests not written), and ISS-0092 (CRITICAL) is open; both are listed in not_built (stage 1) and in the passports. REQ-004 and REQ-005 are done on owner exceptions (decisions/0103, 0104): their re-check reads the exception, it cannot restore the lost output.

Question to ORCH: the scope has 41 chosen rows plus 42 requirements; with ten agents at a time (decisions/0129) it fits. If the plan has to be smaller, the rows with the weakest reason are docs coverage and records security (reasons rest on one measured fact each); no row is marked «можно перенести» because none is chosen by age alone.
